name: Orders UI
description: UI components, hooks, and state management for order operations. Includes order listing, detail views, status management, and filtering.

components.name: OrderCard
components.description: Card component for displaying order summary

components.name: OrderList
components.description: List component with loading, error, empty states and status filters

components.name: OrderDetail
components.description: Detailed view for single order with status actions

components.name: OrderStatusBadge
components.description: Status badge components for order and payment status

hooks.name: useOrder
hooks.description: Hook for single order operations (fetch, update status, cancel)

hooks.name: useOrders
hooks.description: Hook for order list operations (fetch, filter, pagination)

stores.name: useOrderStore
stores.description: Zustand store for order state management

ai.summary: Complete UI module for order management with components, hooks, and Zustand store. Follows Single Responsibility Principle with separate hooks for single and list operations.
use_cases: Display order list with filtering by status
Show order details with status actions
Handle order status transitions (confirm, ship, deliver, cancel)
examples: const { orders, fetchOrders, setFilter } = useOrders({ status: 'pending' })

author: Bebarter Team
